scope: The exact source archive passes the platform-applicable offline transparency proof, RFC 6962 inclusion, C2SP Ed25519 checkpoint and witness verification, threshold release authorization, trust-root recovery and rotation, verified process, Control release and operation, signed-but-unlogged target migration, and strict deployment-control lint checks on Linux, macOS, and Windows.

commands.command: cargo +1.96.0 clippy -p deis-provider-driver -p deis-control -p deis-queue -p deis-store -p deis-telemetry --all-targets -- -D warnings

checks.note: Unix process-group, installation-root ownership and mode, trust material, root rotation, transparency, transient spawn retry, and real shell release and credential process checks are enabled.

Windows compiles and runs DSSE/Ed25519 authorization, C2SP Ed25519 log and timestamped witness verification, RFC 6962 inclusion, root rotation and migration, non-share-write trust-root loading with reparse-point rejection, public stdin, and Job Object boundaries; Unix-only checks are not compiled.

collectionObservations.description: The first SSH command used a locally double-quoted remote script, so the local Bash expanded remote variables before macOS received it and no product check ran.
collectionObservations.resolution: The passing collection sent the script through a quoted remote standard-input boundary, preserving every remote variable literally.

collectionObservations.description: The corrected non-login SSH shell did not place the installed Rust toolchain on PATH, so Cargo was not found and no Rust check ran.
collectionObservations.resolution: The passing collection explicitly loaded /Users/leo/.cargo/env before recording tool versions and running the checks.

collectionObservations.description: Two initial SSH command spellings allowed a local or remote POSIX shell to expand PowerShell variables, producing parser errors before any product check ran.
collectionObservations.resolution: The passing collection transported the PowerShell 5.1 program with UTF-16LE -EncodedCommand, used ErrorActionPreference=Continue, and treated LASTEXITCODE as the native command result.

limitations: The release, keys, roots, rotation envelopes, log checkpoint, witness cosignature, and process fixtures are synthetic; this evidence does not execute a real signed Wrangler, EdgeOne, Deislet, or other provider release or account.

The verifier implements an offline C2SP-compatible Ed25519 checkpoint and timestamped witness subset, but this evidence does not submit to or monitor a real public transparency log or independently operated witness service.

The v1 contract fixes Ed25519 signature types 0x01 and 0x04 and does not implement the ML-DSA-44 branch added by the evolving C2SP specifications; adding that branch requires a versioned contract evolution.
Windows rejects reparse points and concurrent write or delete sharing while reading trust material, but service-account DACL ownership is not validated.
The registry and dispatcher have no public API, CLI, or Web management surface and no background execution loop in this evidence.
The exact archive does not contain generated Control dashboard assets, so the existing build warning and dashboard 404 remain outside this Rust control-path record.
macOS and Windows did not run the shared-contract Python script; the same exact archive passed all 16 schemas and 48 fixtures on Linux.
Passing contract, unit, migration, and lint checks does not certify any backend against Edge Canon.
